verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Angular ships an official CLI test runner (`ng test`) and community accounts describe Angular as historically 'obsessed with testability' with built-in tooling like Karma/Protractor enabling easy testing, implying first-party support for component testing. However, no evidence pack item explicitly documents Angular's component-isolation testing utilities (e.g., TestBed, ComponentFixture) or shows hands-on usage for rendering/interacting with components in isolation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TestBed/ComponentFixture APIs, first-party guide on isolated component rendering/interaction, and independent corroboration of these utilities working as described.
